notes.title: Wardudes update 1.47

notes.title: Wardudes update 1.46
notes.content:
The new Wardudes update is out now!

Version 1.46 features some cool aesthetics improvements, in preparation for story mode!

[list]
[*]Completely remodeled faces, now with animated eyes and mouths

notes.title: WARDUDES BETA RELEASE
notes.content:
Merry Christmas everyone!

Thank you for playing Wardudes during this last year and giving my project a chance even in the alpha stage!

To celebrate Wardudes turning 1 year old, here's update 1.45 also known as the [b]beta release[/b]

With this update we added:

[b]Non gameplay related[/b]
[list]
[*]New and improved textures for every model of the game, including terrains
[*]Improved tree models and particle effects
[*]Improved drop plane model (now with a pilot in it!)
[*]Winter themed main menu
[*]Dudes now drop with a parachute when the game starts
[/list]
[b]Gameplay related[/b]
[list]
[*][b]2 vehicles: the tank and the jeep, each with specific mechanics![/b]
[*][b]Hiding bushes, to make yourself immune from bullets![/b]
[*][b]Coconuts falling from palm trees when you hit them (watch your head!)[/b]
[/list]

We also fixed some old bugs and drastically improved performance in the lobby menu!

[i]More vehicles will be added in future updates, along with new weapons, items and maps![/i]
[b]...there's also a new game mode currently being designed...[/b]

Let us know what you think about this update and if you find any bugs or have some suggestion to make please join our [url=https://discord.gg/rvzUQCSR2D]Discord Server[/url]!

notes.title: Wardudes Update 1.44
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here's update 1.44 of Wardudes, the last one before the [b]beta release![/b]

With this update we added:

[list]
[*][b]Controls settings[/b]
Change the controls to suit your preference!
[*][b]New languages[/b]
The game is now also localized in Russian and Chinese! Also, the tutorial has been translated in all available languages, and some existing translations were improved!
[/list]

We're working hard on getting the beta release ready for December, so get ready for it!

[u][i]Remember that with the beta release, the price will increase.[/i][/u]

Want to participate in the betterment of Wardudes? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rvzUQCSR2D]Discord Server[/url] and let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: Wardudes Update 1.43
notes.content:
Welcome back!

Update 1.43 brings only one new thing to Wardudes, but it's a pretty important one:

[b]The tutorial![/b]

[i]Finally we can understand how you do things in this game![/i]

The tutorial shows you the different classes and their starting items, in a new "Boot Camp" map created specifically for it!

Now it's only available in English, but In later updates it will be translated and improved to give more and better information.

notes.title: Wardudes Update 1.42
notes.content:
Hello comrades!

It took some time, but update 1.42 is here, with a lot of new and improved things!

[b]Major changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Nutshots and headshots effect, with custom death animations (they have no gameplay effect at the moment)
[*]Badly hurt dudes now have a cast on a random limb, and they walk slower
[*]Sprint button has been disabled, base walking speed is increased
[*]Crouching speed is decreased, now crouching disables detection from mines and turrets
[*]Changed all the starting items of each class (I need your feedback about this)
[*]Dudes now have animated hands with fingers, all animations have been updated with hand gestures, and new animations have been added!
[*]New weapon: [b]The Raygun[/b] 
Shoot an electric ray to your enemy to shock them to the bone, and create an electrical chain effect with all the other nearby dudes!
[/list]

[b]Minor changes[/b]
[list]
[*]New splashy blood effect
[*]Jetpack fuel duration decreased
[*]Eccess damage is now shown when a dude is killed instead of it being rouded up to their remaining HP
[/list]

Want to participate in the betterment of Wardudes? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rvzUQCSR2D]Discord Server[/url] and let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: Wardudes Update 1.28
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The day has finally arrived:
[b]Wardudes goes online![/b]

As promised, with update 1.28 the online mode is now available!

And there's something more:

[list]
[*]Improved crate drop locations, no more crates in the open sea!
[*]Added different models for weapon drops and health kit drops
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes the character would start walking by itself
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes the game won't pick the dudes in the correct order
[*]Completely reworked the bullets, now they have a more "realistic" drop, and better hit registration!
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes changing team colors cleared the dudes names
[*]Fixed a bug where the drop rate was always kept to 100%
[/list]

There's still a lot of cleanup to do, but I couldn't wait any longer to show you the online mode! Next friday there will be another update to fix many small issues I'm already aware of, and if you signal any issue on [b]Discord[/b] I'll give it a look ASAP! 

Want to participate in the betterment of Wardudes? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rvzUQCSR2D]Discord Server[/url] and let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: Wardudes Update 1.27
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for patiently waiting for new updates! Things are quietly evolving!

This update is a transitional one, 
the only differences you'll see are the new [b]game creation UI[/b] and a slightly different game camera behaviour (and probably some new bugs here and there, please tell us on [b]Discord[/b] if you find any)

The new code is much more flexible than the old one, and is VERY close to be ready for the [b]online mode![/b]

notes.title: Wardudes Update 1.26
notes.content:
Hello dudes and dudettes!

Thank you for playing Wardudes during the first week of release, and thank you to everyone who joined the Discord server and gave us their feedback about the game!

As promised, we listened to you feedback and after just 7 days we managed to fix and tune in many aspects of the game:

[b]Bugs/performance fix:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved performance when camera gets near/under water
[*]Fixed a bug where the paracute of drops collided with trees
[*]Fixed a bug where mines could explode during turn start, dealing no damage
[*]Fixed a bug where explosive barrels didn't deal damage
[*]Heavily reduced the chance of getting items to fall through the terrain by standing on them
[/list]

[b]Game balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*]The shovel now removes 5 seconds from your timer each time you use it
[*]Grenades now do more damage in a slightly bigger area
[*]Tnt now does less damage in a slightly smaller area
[*]Gunner class now has 2 barbed wire fences instead of 3
[*]Machine gun now does 10 dmg for each bullet hit (instead of 15)
[*]Medic syringe now heals 25 instead of 40, but doesn't end turn (can still be used on yourself)
[/list]

[b]Other improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Non-controlled Dudes thrown in water are now less dumb when it comes to find land
[*]Getting out of water is now easier
[*]Non-controlled Dudes now automatically jump away when on top of another Dude's head
[*]Changed the animation for when the ragdoll ends while under water (still work in progress)
[*]Landmines can now explode when hit by a bullet
[/list]

Want to participate in the betterment of Wardudes? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rvzUQCSR2D]Discord Server[/url] and let us know your thoughts!
